headline: Fresh Fighting Sweeps Stlican Shelf and Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Since the last bulletin, Weathered Expanse remains the busiest map, while Stlican Shelf has returned to heavy action. Weathered Expanse reports fifty-five strongpoint events over the past day and fresh events in the latest two hours; four Warden strongpoints, four Colonial strongpoints, and one unrecovered strongpoint make up the line. Stlican Shelf has logged thirty-six day-events and five in the latest two hours; there, too, each side holds four strongpoints, with one lying in no-man's-land. Godcrofts has revived, with six events in the latest two hours and twenty-eight in the day, although Colonials hold eight of the region's nine strongpoints. Stonecradle is similarly active, logging three events in the latest two hours and twenty-eight in a day; Wardens hold six positions to Colonials' three. LinnMercy's ledger is unchanged at six Warden strongpoints to five Colonial, but the latest two hours have quieted after a busy interval; its day-total is twenty-seven. Fishermans Row has slackened, yet still reports fifteen day-events and now stands eight Warden strongpoints against one Colonial. DeadLands remains still, with no strongpoint event in the last six hours after an earlier burst. Callahan's Passage, quiet in the previous bulletin, shows two fresh events in the latest two hours.
